rules.selection: 5-session Minervini RS (3/6/12M 40/30/30) percentile 50% + point-in-time EPS/revenue percentile 50%, top 10

universe.rule: execution year y uses snapshot y-1

limitations: DART is missing for some annual-universe names; only those signal candidates are excluded and each rebalance records dartCandidateCount.
Annual membership reduces but does not eliminate delisting, halt, and historical-liquidity bias.
